entities.summary: Asenovgrad is a town in central southern Bulgaria, part of Plovdiv Province. It is the largest town in Bulgaria that is not a province center. Previously known as Stanimaka, it was renamed in 1934 after the 13th-century tsar Ivan Asen II.
